description: Hard pass/fail gates enforced BEFORE scoring. Any REJECT reason removes an opportunity from the acquisition pipeline. This is the Google-Webmaster-Guidelines compliance layer: it exists to keep the engine white-hat and to keep us OFF risky sources, regardless of how high a domain's DR looks.

spamFlagPresent.reason: Any of these flags = never pursue

authorityFloorFail.reason: Zero-value profile links: no authority, no traffic, no editorial context

worthlessFootprint.reason: Classic web2.0 churn pattern: mid DR, zero real traffic, generic blog TLD

warnIf.paidRequired: cost != 'free' -> requires human budget approval before pursuit
warnIf.nofollowOnly: dofollow == false -> still valuable for citations/trust/traffic, but flag so anchor mix stays natural
warnIf.lowIndexation: indexed == false -> hold until the linking page is confirmed indexed by Google

anchorTextPolicy.note: Keep anchor distribution natural to avoid over-optimization penalties

velocityPolicy.note: Sustainable, natural link velocity. Do not spike.
